# mvstmt: extract code with isTerm checking complex break patterns
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int, ch chan int) int {
	// BEGIN
	switch x {
	case 0:
		select {
		case <-ch:
			return 0
		default:
			return -1
		}
	case 1:
		switch x {
		case 1:
			return 1
		default:
			return -1
		}
	default:
		return x
	}
	// END
}
